description: This file implements the ProcessInfo class and related functionalities for process management, including retrieving process details, memory usage, and process trees across different operating systems.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents a process, providing methods to retrieve process details, memory usage, command line, and process hierarchy.

classes.name: ProcessInfo::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class to traverse processes based on various criteria such as name, parent process, or process ID.

classes.name: ProcessInfo::Memory
classes.description: Encapsulates memory statistics for a process, including working set, resident set, shared memory, and detailed memory stats.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a process tree starting from a specific process, allowing to check containment and retrieve process IDs.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Provides information and control over the current process, including user and group management.

methods.name: ExecutableName
methods.description: Retrieves the executable path or name for a given process handle or PID, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: ProcessName
methods.description: Retrieves the process name or path for a given PID, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: FindChildren
methods.description: Finds child processes of a given process ID, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: FindPid
methods.description: Finds process IDs matching a given process name, with exact or partial match.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::ProcessInfo
methods.description: Constructs a ProcessInfo object for the current process or a specific process ID.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Allocated
methods.description: Returns the allocated memory size of the process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Resident
methods.description: Returns the resident memory size of the process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Shared
methods.description: Returns the shared memory size of the process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Name
methods.description: Returns the executable name of the process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Executable
methods.description: Returns the full path of the process executable.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::CommandLine
methods.description: Returns the command line arguments used to start the process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::FindByName
methods.description: Finds processes matching a given name.

methods.name: ProcessCurrent::User
methods.description: Returns the username of the current process owner.

methods.name: ProcessCurrent::User
methods.description: Sets the user ID of the current process based on username.

methods.name: ProcessCurrent::SupplementryGroups
methods.description: Sets supplementary groups for the current process based on username.

methods.name: ProcessCurrent::Group
methods.description: Returns the group name of the current process.

methods.name: ProcessCurrent::Group
methods.description: Sets the group ID of the current process based on group name.

methods.name: EnumerateChildProcesses
methods.description: Recursively enumerates child processes of a given process.

methods.name: ProcessTree::ContainsProcess
methods.description: Checks if a process ID is within the process tree.

methods.name: ProcessTree::GetProcessIds
methods.description: Retrieves all process IDs within the process tree.

methods.name: ProcessTree::RootId
methods.description: Returns the root process ID of the process tree.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Memory::Memory
methods.description: Constructs a memory info object for a process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Memory::MemoryStats
methods.description: Collects detailed memory statistics for the process from /proc/<pid>/smaps.
